function: Wideband near-field uplink channel estimation for XL-MIMO from compressed pilots, posed as image super-resolution (p. 1, p. 2).
system: Uplink XL-MIMO, ULA BS with N=128 antennas, 4 RF chains, single-antenna users, OFDM M=32 subcarriers, 28 GHz; no RIS (p. 2, p. 4).
method: Model-driven iterative network from half-quadratic splitting: per layer a CNN prior step plus learnable gradient-descent step; supervised MSE training, Adam, L=15 layers (p. 3, p. 4).
data_channel: Own simulated near-field Saleh-Valenzuela multipath channel; 10000 training, 2000 testing, 2000 validation samples; user distance U(10 m, 30 m) (p. 2, p. 4).
test_conditions: Trained and tested on the same simulated channel distribution; test sweeps over SNR 5-25 dB and 16-28 pilots; no unseen scenario or fine-tuning reported (p. 4, p. 5).
baselines: Classical: P-OMP, BPD-SOMP, SBL. Learned: SBL-Net, SDL-LISTA, DnCNN-based data-driven estimator (p. 4).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR and versus number of pilots; validation loss versus number of layers; parameter count and online estimation time (p. 4, p. 5).
complexity: Table I: 2.78 M parameters and 5.7840 s online estimation time for MDISR-Net, compared with the other methods (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 2: "According to the Saleh-Valenzuela (SV) multi-path channel"; own near-field SV simulator, no 3GPP TR 38.901 model, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 4: "10000, 2000 and 2000 channel samples for training, testing"; test samples come from the same simulated distribution. Fig. 2 sweeps the SNR and Fig. 3 the pilots (16 to 28), but the paper never says the model was trained at other pilot numbers, retrained, or fine-tuned.
q3_support: p. 4: "polar-domain OMP (P-OMP)"; p. 4: "apply the denoising CNN (DnCNN) in [8]"; p. 4: "investigated with normalized MSE (NMSE)"; non-learned P-OMP, BPD-SOMP, SBL and learned SBL-Net, SDL-LISTA, DnCNN are compared on NMSE (Figs. 2 and 3).
q4_support: p. 5: "time cost of online estimation in Table I"; Table I lists 2.78 M parameters and 5.7840 s online estimation time for MDISR-Net, and the same two measures for the other methods.
q5_support: p. 4: "10000, 2000 and 2000 channel samples for training, testing"; the samples are generated by the authors' own simulator, and no code or data link, DOI or release statement appears anywhere in the paper.
notes: PDF checked: title and DOI 10.1109/LWC.2024.3497598 on p. 1 match. Included, area 2 (channel estimation); MDISR-Net has trained parameters, BS has 128 antennas, no RIS. Table I values were read from the image of p. 5, since the table body is missing from the extracted text. q2: Fig. 3 varies the pilots, but the paper does not say whether the model was retrained per pilot number or tested outside its training pilots, so q2 is 0 under the explicit-statement rule; the reviewer may confirm. The paper calls one baseline BPD-SOMP in Section IV and BPD-OMP in the discussion of Figs. 2 and 3.
